title: Wrapping up: playing with everybody in New Orleans
summary: Dutre has nothing more to add and says he played with practically every band; musicians switched easily since the style was shared.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah, I hadn't known about him. Is there anything else about your life, the late years in music or anything else you'd like to add? I think that covers most of your lives. Yes, it's about, I don't know.
There isn't anything more I could say too much. I may think of something after I leave. I know it's always that way.
Yeah. The next day people say, well I should have told you about a certain band or something I did. But anyway, you can't think of everything.

But I played with practically everybody. I mean, I could say a lot of bands I played with, probably the Black Eagle bands of New Orleans. Oh yeah. I played with King Thomas, Kit Thomas from CrossFit. Oh yeah. I played with every band you have. Yeah, most people, most people usually say that too.
The New Orleans musicians would just change from one to another. They all played the same style mostly, so they could all switch from one band to another
